names.note: Name page 9460 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Алексий (Ильинский), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Алексия пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1931)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 22 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера (1931).»

attestations.note: The day's fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 9460 «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. NO FOLDER HELD HIM, BUT THE SURNAME IS NOT NEW TO THE CORPUS: a Cyrillic grep for «Ильинский» over every `saint.json` returns `alexander-ilyinsky`, `demetrius-ilyinsky`, `john-ilyinsky` and `victor-ilyinsky`, four other forenames and four other days, and `fk.mjs` on «Алексий (Ильинский)» returns NONE. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
